newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia undertakes a major educational project to help over 880 teachers in Bosnia.
- Information minister calls on Arab countries to enhance cooperation in the information sector.
- Riyadh governor signs three contracts worth 200 million riyals.
- Saudi Petrochemical Co (Sadaf) inaugurates a chemical plant built at a cost of 1.4 billion riyals. AL-YAUM
- A Korean trade delegation to visit Saudi Arabia in October to hold talks with officials.
- A 200-million-riyal recreation project to be opened in Jeddah soon.
